bio.text: William Tong has been Connecticut's Attorney General since 2019 and is the Democratic nominee for re-election in 2026.

Before that he served 12 years as a state representative, including as House chairman of the Judiciary Committee, and practiced for 18 years as a litigator, at Simpson Thacher & Bartlett in New York and Finn Dixon & Herling in Stamford.
He grew up in the Hartford area, graduated from Phillips Academy Andover, Brown University and the University of Chicago Law School, and lives in Stamford.
